RAG Scam Detector

runs on my laptop, no cloud needed

You paste in a suspicious message. The app checks it for known warning signs, finds related entries in a scam-awareness knowledge base, and a local language model explains what it found. It covers six scam types (phishing, fake job, investment, impersonation, payment fraud and romance) and gives a risk level from low to critical.

I also wrote an evaluation script and a 60-message synthetic test set to measure precision, recall and F1.

Python · Flask · ChromaDB · Sentence Transformers · Ollama

Prism Pulse AR

A browser experience that tracks your hands through the webcam and turns your fingertips into glowing particle trails. Bring both hands close and arcs of light jump between them. It recognizes pinch, open hand, fist and two-hand poses, makes sound with the Web Audio API, and has five themes and a settings panel.

JavaScript · MediaPipe Hands · Canvas · Web Audio · Vite

Student Performance Analysis

attendance mattered more than hours studied

I analyzed 6,607 student records and 20 variables with Pandas and Matplotlib. Attendance has a correlation of 0.58 with exam scores, against 0.45 for study hours. Sleep hours and physical activity show very weak linear relationships. The project has scatter plots, a bar chart and a correlation heatmap.

Python · Pandas · Matplotlib
